description: A React component for viewing and editing detailed information about a machine learning model, including settings, credentials, and related actions such as testing connection and deletion.

methods.name: handleReuseCredential
methods.description: Handles storing a new credential for the model by calling credentialCreateCall and showing notifications.

methods.name: handleModelUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating the model's configuration by parsing form values, calling API update, and updating local state.

methods.name: handleTestConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the model provider and shows success or error notifications.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the model via API call and updates parent component.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies specified text to clipboard and shows visual feedback.

methods.name: handleAutoRouterUpdate
methods.description: Updates local model data after editing auto router configuration.
